newsitem.title: USA: Muni yield curve steepens over past week - Delphis.
newsitem.headline: Muni yield curve steepens over past week - Delphis.

text.p: The municipal yield curve steepened about 10 basis points in the week ended Thursday, after steepening five to 15 basis points the prior week, Delphis Hanover Corp said Friday.

The triple-A yield curve between one-year and 30-year munis was the only credit range in which the curve remained unchanged, at 200 basis points. The Baa scale steepened 10 basis points to 205 basis points.
Overall yields on average rose between five and 15 basis points on the week.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated municipal yields rose five basis points to 5.55 percent. Thirty-year Baa yields were 15 basis points higher, moving to at 6.40 percent.
Over the same period, the Treasury long bond rose 11 basis points to 6.62 percent. Thirty-year, Aaa-rated munis were yielding 83.8 percent of the Treasury long bond at the close Thursday.
Average yields on one-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds were up five basis points to 3.55 percent. In the Baa sector, one-year munis also rose five basis points to 4.35 percent.
In the intermediate sector, ten-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds were up 10 basis points to 4.80 percent. Yields on 10-year Baa-rated munis gained 15 basis points, moving to 5.65 percent.
The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years was unchanged at 80 basis points, while the 30-year spread widened 10 basis points to 85 basis points.
